2. **P2 — Pack restrictions change after JSON storage.**  
   [pack.ex:362](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/catalog/pack.ex:362) accepts all atom filter keys. The string-key path recognizes only some keys. Thus `%{ status: :unavailable}` excludes an available provider, but the same pack returns that provider after JSON encoding and decoding. `category`, `visibility`, `package`, and other provider filters have the same problem. Use one supported-key list for atom and string keys. Reject unsupported keys with a validation error.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
